typography.usage: Titles and short section openings; source slide 9 / recommendation.
Reading text, supporting labels and detailed explanations; source slide 9 / navTest.

recognitionRules: Use rounded display lettering with a Memphis-style geometric plate.
Pair plum and pink fields with selective lime accents.
Give the central future question a large quiet area distinct from logistics.
Keep quiet writing, speaking and passing visible as equal participation routes.

principles: Make the invitation warm and the practical details exact.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Imagine one possible day. Name what you would keep, and what would need to change.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid speaking for an entire community or implying confirmed attendance.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: Come for the part that interests you; here is what to expect.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use POSSIBLE COMMONS in rounded lettering with three offset open geometric pieces. Avoid a closed emblem that suggests one agreed future.
invariants: Use rounded display lettering with a Memphis-style geometric plate.
Pair plum and pink fields with selective lime accents.
Give the central future question a large quiet area distinct from logistics.
adaptations: Use fewer geometric pieces on worksheets so responses have space.
Let scenario content vary while participation options remain stable.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Arial Rounded MT Bold is a separately licensed system font; not bundled.
Trebuchet MS is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
